name: Explain chemistry and biology concepts and design experiments
description: Users requested explanations of core chemistry and molecular biology concepts, factual data on chemical substances, and the design of experimental protocols for synthesis, analysis, and genetic engineering. They also asked for assistance in solving chemical equations, balancing reactions, and calculating thermodynamic properties.
